ts
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountWorkspaceSettings } from '../templates/account/settings/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountWorkspaceSettings(
		element,
		{ i18n, inheritAppearance: true },
		onError
	);
	return result;
}

import { computed, reactive, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n, AsamI18nCall } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageIssue, formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { accountMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import { safeReturnPath, scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type {
	AccountHost,
	AccountProfile,
	AccountRequest,
	AccountSettings,
	Registration,
	RegistrationField,
	SettingsField,
	Verification,
	WriteResult
} from './Types.js';

const emptySettings = (): AccountSettings => ({
	displayName: '',
	email: '',
	phone: '',
	language: 'zh-CN',
	notifications: false,
	digest: false
});
const text = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : '');
export function safeProfile(value: AccountProfile): AccountProfile {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		organization: text(value.organization),
		role: text(value.role),
		joined: text(value.joined),
		avatar: safeAccountUrl(value.avatar),
		website: safeAccountUrl(value.website)
	};
}
/** No data/blob/protocol-relative URLs. Host should restrict remote hosts further. */
export function safeAccountUrl(value: unknown): string | undefined {
	// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Reject URL control characters, as before.
	if (typeof value !== 'string' || /[\\\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(value)) return;
	if (value.startsWith('/') && !value.startsWith('//') && !/%[0-9a-f]{2}/i.test(value))
		return value;
	try {
		const url = new URL(value);
		return url.protocol === 'https:' && !url.username && !url.password ? url.href : undefined;
	} catch {
		return;
	}
}
function copySettings(value: AccountSettings): AccountSettings {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		language: text(value.language),
		notifications: value.notifications === true,
		digest: value.digest === true,
		...(typeof value.biography === 'string' ? { biography: value.biography } : {}),
		...(typeof value.officeArea === 'string' ? { officeArea: value.officeArea } : {})
	};
}
type MessageIssue = ReturnType<typeof createAsamMessageIssue>;
function feedback<Field extends string>(owner?: AsamI18n) {
	const scope = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, accountMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const message = ref('');
	const source = shallowRef<MessageIssue>();
	const sources = shallowRef<Partial<Record<Field, MessageIssue>>>({});
	const errors = ref<Partial<Record<Field, string>>>({});
	function setMessage(legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall | []) {
		message.value = legacy;
		source.value = call.length ? createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call) : undefined;
	}
	return {
		message,
		errors,
		sources,
		setMessage,
		displayMessage: computed(() =>
			scope && source.value ? formatFieldIssue(source.value, scope) : message.value
		),
		displayErrors: computed(
			() =>
				Object.fromEntries(
					Object.entries(errors.value).map(([key, value]) => [
						key,
						scope && sources.value[key as Field]
							? formatFieldIssue(sources.value[key as Field]!, scope)
							: value
					])
				) as Partial<Record<Field, string>>
		),
		dispose: () => scope?.dispose()
	};
}
export function registrationIssues(
	host: AccountHost,
	value: Registration & { confirm: string },
	sources: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: RegistrationField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N}_.-]{3,40}$/u.test(value.account))
		add(
			'account',
			'用户名需为3至40个字母、数字或 _ . -',
			'app.templates.account.accountInvalid'
		);
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.password.length < (host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8))
		add(
			'password',
			`密码至少${host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8}位`,
			'app.templates.account.passwordShort',
			{ minimum: host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8 }
		);
	if (value.password !== value.confirm)
		add('confirm', '两次输入的密码不一致', 'app.templates.account.passwordMismatch');
	if (host.registration?.requireConsent !== false && !value.consent)
		add('consent', '请先同意账户使用条款', 'app.templates.account.consentRequired');
	const hostErrors = host.registration?.validate?.(value);
	for (const key of Object.keys(hostErrors ?? {})) delete sources[key as RegistrationField];
	return { ...errors, ...hostErrors };
}
export function settingsIssues(
	value: AccountSettings,
	host: AccountHost,
	sources: Partial<Record<SettingsField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<SettingsField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: SettingsField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!value.displayName.trim() || value.displayName.length > 60)
		add('displayName', '显示名需为1至60个字符', 'app.templates.account.nameInvalid');
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.phone && !/^[+\d ()-]{5,30}$/.test(value.phone))
		add('phone', '请填写有效联系电话或留空', 'app.templates.account.phoneInvalid');
	if (
		!(host.languages ?? [{ value: 'zh-CN' }, { value: 'en' }]).some(
			(i) => i.value === value.language
		)
	)
		add('language', '请选择支持的语言', 'app.templates.account.languageInvalid');
	return errors;
}

/** Page-owned requests only. Security/transport state machines remain in 033/035. */
function owner(host: AccountHost, invalidate: () => void) {
	let version = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	const requests = new Set<AbortController>();
	function clear() {
		++version;
		const prior = [...requests];
		requests.clear();
		invalidate();
		for (const request of prior) request.abort();
	}
	const remove = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const stop = watch(
		() => {
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			return JSON.stringify([
				state.epoch,
				state.status,
				state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject)
			]);
		},
		clear,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		clear,
		request(operationId: string, protectedRead = false): AccountRequest & { release(): void } {
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requests.add(controller);
			const revision = version;
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			const identity = state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject);
			return {
				operationId,
				signal: controller.signal,
				isCurrent: () =>
					!disposed &&
					!controller.signal.aborted &&
					revision === version &&
					(!protectedRead ||
						(host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated' &&
							!!host.security.state.value.subject &&
							host.security.state.value.epoch === state.epoch &&
							scopeKey(host.security.state.value.subject) === identity)),
				release: () => requests.delete(controller)
			};
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			remove();
			clear();
		}
	};
}

/** 可选设置面板复用同一页面请求归属，不另建安全或写入状态机。 */
export { owner as createAccountRequestScope };

export function createRegistration(host: AccountHost, i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	const display = feedback<RegistrationField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const draft = reactive<Registration & { confirm: string }>({
		account: '',
		email: '',
		password: '',
		confirm: '',
		consent: false
	});
	const status = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const operationId = ref('');
	const secretClear = () => {
		draft.password = '';
		draft.confirm = '';
	};
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		Object.assign(draft, { account: '', email: '', password: '', confirm: '', consent: false });
		status.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
	});
	function accept(result: WriteResult<RegistrationField>) {
		status.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure') setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('提交结果待核实，请勿重复注册', 'app.templates.account.registrationUnknown');
		else
			setMessage(
				'请检查标出的字段后重新填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.registrationFields'
			);
	}
	async function submit(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown', 'success'].includes(status.value)) return false;
		try {
			sources.value = {};
			errors.value = registrationIssues(host, draft, sources.value);
		} catch {
			setMessage('字段校验未能完成', 'app.templates.account.validationFailed');
			return false;
		}
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			status.value = 'field-error';
			return false;
		}
		const input: Registration = {
			account: draft.account,
			email: draft.email,
			password: draft.password,
			consent: draft.consent
		};
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		secretClear();
		try {
			const result = await host.services.register(input, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			input.password = '';
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || status.value !== 'unknown' || !host.services.verifyRegistration)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.verifyRegistration(operationId.value, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					status.value = 'idle';
					setMessage(
						'已核实未写入，可重新填写密码后提交',
						'app.templates.account.registrationNotWritten'
					);
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		draft,
		status,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		submit,
		verify,
		secretClear,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

type AccountNotificationField = 'notifications' | 'digest';
type LocalNotificationField = 'projectUpdates' | 'systemNotices';
export type NotificationChange = {
	field: AccountNotificationField | LocalNotificationField;
	value: boolean;
};

/** Optional page-local draft companion; never adds keys to AccountSettings or its payload. */
export interface AccountSettingsCompanion {
	dirty(): boolean;
	loaded(operationId: string): void;
	capture(operationId: string, notification?: NotificationChange): void;
	accept(operationId: string): void;
	rollbackNotification?(operationId: string): void;
	revert(): void;
	clear(): void;
}
export function createAccountData(
	host: AccountHost,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	companion?: AccountSettingsCompanion
) {
	const display = feedback<SettingsField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const profile = ref<AccountProfile | null>(null);
	const profileStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'empty' | 'error'>('idle');
	const draft = reactive(emptySettings());
	function replaceDraft(value: AccountSettings) {
		delete draft.biography;
		delete draft.officeArea;
		Object.assign(draft, value);
	}
	const original = ref(emptySettings());
	const settingsStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('idle');
	const saveStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const displayStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
	const operationId = ref('');
	let savedPayload: AccountSettings | undefined;
	let savedNotification: NotificationChange | undefined;
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'idle';
		replaceDraft(emptySettings());
		original.value = emptySettings();
		settingsStatus.value = 'idle';
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
		savedPayload = undefined;
		savedNotification = undefined;
		companion?.clear();
	});
	const dirty = computed(
		() => JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(original.value) || !!companion?.dirty()
	);
	const subject = () =>
		host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated'
			? host.security.state.value.subject
			: null;
	const allowed = (write = false) =>
		host.security.check({ permission: write ? 'account:write' : 'account:read', write }) ===
		'allowed';
	let profileRevision = 0,
		settingsRevision = 0;
	async function loadProfile(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (blocked || !person || !allowed()) return;
		const revision = ++profileRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.profile(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision && allowed()) {
				profile.value = result && safeProfile(result);
				profileStatus.value = result ? 'ready' : 'empty';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision) profileStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function loadSettings(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			saveStatus.value === 'unknown' ||
			dirty.value
		)
			return;
		const revision = ++settingsRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		settingsStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.settings(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision && allowed()) {
				original.value = copySettings(result);
				replaceDraft(original.value);
				companion?.loaded(request.operationId);
				settingsStatus.value = 'ready';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision)
				settingsStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	function revert(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)) return;
		replaceDraft(original.value);
		companion?.revert();
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
	}
	function accept(result: WriteResult<SettingsField>) {
		saveStatus.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedNotification)
			setMessage('通知偏好已保存', 'app.templates.account.notificationSaved');
		else if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure')
			setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('保存结果待核实，请勿再次保存', 'app.templates.account.saveUnknown');
		else setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedPayload) {
			original.value = copySettings(savedPayload);
			if (!savedNotification) replaceDraft(original.value);
			companion?.accept(operationId.value);
		} else if (result.status !== 'unknown') rollbackNotification();
	}
	function rollbackNotification() {
		const field = savedNotification?.field;
		if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') draft[field] = original.value[field];
		if (field) companion?.rollbackNotification?.(operationId.value);
	}
	async function save(blocked = false, notification?: NotificationChange) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed(true) ||
			settingsStatus.value !== 'ready' ||
			(!notification && !dirty.value) ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)
		)
			return false;
		const payload = notification ? copySettings(original.value) : copySettings(draft);
		const field = notification?.field;
		if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest')) {
			if (payload[field] === notification.value) return false;
			payload[field] = notification.value;
		} else if (notification && !companion) return false;
		sources.value = {};
		errors.value = settingsIssues(notification ? payload : draft, host, sources.value);
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			saveStatus.value = 'field-error';
			if (notification) setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
			return false;
		}
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		savedPayload = payload;
		savedNotification = notification;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		try {
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed(true)) return false;
			companion?.capture(operationId.value, notification);
			if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest'))
				draft[field] = notification.value;
			const result = await host.services.save(person, savedPayload, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'unknown' ||
			!host.services.verifySave
		)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result: Verification<SettingsField> = await host.services.verifySave(
				person,
				operationId.value,
				request
			);
			if (request.isCurrent() && allowed()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					rollbackNotification();
					saveStatus.value = 'idle';
					setMessage('已核实未写入，可重新保存', 'app.templates.account.saveNotWritten');
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function refreshDisplay(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'success' ||
			displayStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			!host.services.refreshDisplay
		)
			return;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		displayStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			await host.services.refreshDisplay(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		profile,
		profileStatus,
		draft,
		original,
		dirty,
		settingsStatus,
		saveStatus,
		displayStatus,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		allowed,
		loadProfile,
		loadSettings,
		revert,
		save,
		verify,
		refreshDisplay,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

export function loginDestination(host: AccountHost, value: unknown) {
	const path = safeReturnPath(value, '/account/profile');
	return host.canNavigate(path) ? path : undefined;
}

import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;
import type { SecurityRequest, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

export type AccountFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type AccountPage = 'login' | 'register' | 'profile' | 'settings';
export interface LoginCredentials {
	account: string;
	password: string;
}
export interface Registration extends LoginCredentials {
	email: string;
	consent: boolean;
}
export interface AccountSettings {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	language: string;
	notifications: boolean;
	digest: boolean;
	/** 可选前端资料扩展；未接入的宿主继续只返回原六字段。 */
	biography?: string;
	officeArea?: string;
}
/** Display allowlist. Map backend DTOs at the host boundary. */
export interface AccountProfile {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	organization: string;
	role: string;
	joined: string;
	avatar?: string;
	website?: string;
}
export type RegistrationField = 'account' | 'email' | 'password' | 'confirm' | 'consent';
export type SettingsField = keyof AccountSettings;
/** Messages are display-safe host text, never raw server exceptions/DTOs. */
export type WriteResult<K extends string> =
	| { status: 'success'; message: string }
	| { status: 'field-error'; fields: Partial<Record<K, string>> }
	| { status: 'failure'; message: string }
	| { status: 'unknown' };
export type Verification<K extends string> = WriteResult<K> | { status: 'not-written' };
export interface AccountRequest extends SecurityRequest {
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface AccountServices {
	/** Host must gate authentication/storage side effects with BOTH requests' isCurrent. */
	login(credentials: Readonly<LoginCredentials>, request: AccountRequest): Promise<boolean>;
	register(
		input: Readonly<Registration>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<RegistrationField>>;
	profile(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountProfile | null>;
	settings(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountSettings>;
	save(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		settings: Readonly<AccountSettings>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<SettingsField>>;
	verifyRegistration?(
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<RegistrationField>>;
	verifySave?(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<SettingsField>>;
	/** Refresh the host's display projection only. Must not save again or mutate page drafts. */
	refreshDisplay?(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<void>;
}
export interface AccountHost {
	security: Pick<SecurityController, 'state' | 'check' | 'onInvalidate'>;
	services: AccountServices;
	/** Stable id for one mutation. Generate once, preserve through unknown/verification. */
	operationId(): string;
	/** Explicit host allowlist. safeReturnPath is always applied first. */
	canNavigate(path: string): boolean;
	navigate(path: string): void | Promise<void>;
	/** An escalation action, never an implicit retry. Receives no secrets or payload. */
	resolveUnknown(kind: 'register' | 'save', operationId: string): void;
	registration?: {
		accountLabel?: string;
		minimumPasswordLength?: number;
		requireConsent?: boolean;
		validate?(
			input: Readonly<Registration & { confirm: string }>
		): Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>>;
	};
	languages?: readonly { value: string; label: string }[];
}
export interface AccountPageProps {
	host: AccountHost;
	brand?: string;
	accountLabel?: string;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	returnPath?: unknown;
}
export interface AccountPageEvents {
	page: [page: AccountPage];
	/** Register/save emit once per operation, on direct or verified success in the current page. */
	completed: [kind: 'login' | 'register' | 'save'];
}
export interface AccountPageExpose {
	clear(): void;
}

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type {
	AccountHost,
	AccountProfile,
	AccountRequest,
	AccountSettings,
	LoginCredentials,
	RegistrationField,
	SettingsField,
	WriteResult
} from '../Types.js';
import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

export const exampleBrand = 'ASAM';
export const exampleAccountLabel = '账户';
export type FixtureMode = 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown' | 'empty' | 'late';
/** Synthetic local adapter. No fetch, URL, cookie, token, storage or real account. */
export function createAccountFixture(
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	profileFields?: Pick<AccountSettings, 'biography' | 'officeArea'>
) {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'success' as FixtureMode,
		delay: 0,
		refreshFailure: false,
		readOnly: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		login: 0,
		lastAccount: '',
		register: 0,
		save: 0,
		profile: 0,
		settings: 0,
		verify: 0,
		refresh: 0,
		disposed: false,
		navigations: [] as string[],
		escalations: [] as string[]
	});
	let sequence = 0;
	let currentId: string | number = 0;
	let profileName = '林予安';
	let settings: AccountSettings = {
		displayName: '林予安',
		email: 'lin@example.invalid',
		phone: '+86 010 5555 0186',
		language: 'zh-CN',
		notifications: true,
		digest: false,
		...(typeof profileFields?.biography === 'string'
			? { biography: profileFields.biography }
			: {}),
		...(typeof profileFields?.officeArea === 'string'
			? { officeArea: profileFields.officeArea }
			: {})
	};
	const operations = new Map<string, WriteResult<SettingsField | RegistrationField>>();
	const wait = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, controls.delay));
	const subject = (): SecuritySubject => ({
		id: currentId,
		name: profileName,
		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: ['account:read', 'account:write'],
		scope: { tenant: 0, organization: 0 },
		contexts: [
			{ tenant: 0, organization: 0, label: '演示团队' },
			{ tenant: '0', organization: '0', label: '演示团队 B' }
		],
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000,
		readOnly: controls.readOnly
	});
	const security = createSecurity<LoginCredentials & { caller: AccountRequest }>({
		i18n,
		adapter: {
			async login(credentials, request) {
				audit.login++;
				audit.lastAccount = credentials.account;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || !credentials.caller.isCurrent())
					throw new Error('Cancelled');
				if (controls.mode === 'failure') throw new Error('Synthetic failure');
				return subject();
			},
			async restore(request) {
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent() ? subject() : null;
			},
			async refresh(_subject, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return subject();
			},
			async switchContext(person, scope, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return { ...person, scope };
			},
			async logout() {
				await wait();
			}
		}
	});
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n,
		transport: async (input) => {
			const mode = controls.mode;
			const delay = controls.delay;
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
			if (mode === 'failure') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (input.url === 'fixture:profile') {
				audit.profile++;
				const person = input.data as SecuritySubject;
				return {
					mode: 'data',
					data:
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: {
									displayName: person.id === 0 ? profileName : '顾行舟',
									email: settings.email,
									phone: settings.phone,
									organization: `演示组织 ${String(person.scope.organization)}`,
									role: '应用成员',
									joined: '2026-10-01',
									secret: 'must-not-render'
								}
				};
			}
			if (input.url === 'fixture:settings') {
				audit.settings++;
				return { mode: 'data', data: { ...settings } };
			}
			throw new TransportFault('unknown');
		}
	});
	const host: AccountHost = {
		security,
		operationId: () => `synthetic-${++sequence}`,
		canNavigate: (path) => ['/account/profile', '/account/settings'].includes(path),
		navigate: (path) => {
			audit.navigations.push(path);
		},
		resolveUnknown: (kind, id) => {
			audit.escalations.push(`${kind}:${id}`);
		},
		services: {
			login: (credentials, caller) => security.login({ ...credentials, caller }),
			async register(input, request) {
				audit.register++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<RegistrationField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '该邮箱已用于合成账户' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示注册失败，可修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: `账户 ${input.account} 已创建` };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async profile(person, request) {
				// Each page read owns a Latest wrapper, never a shared mutable global request slot.
				const latest = createLatestRequest<AccountProfile | null>(client, () => undefined);
				try {
					return await latest.load(
						{ url: 'fixture:profile', data: person },
						{
							signal: request.signal,
							decode: (value) => value as AccountProfile | null
						}
					);
				} finally {
					latest.dispose();
				}
			},
			settings: (_person, request) =>
				client.request(
					{ url: 'fixture:settings' },
					{ signal: request.signal, decode: (value) => value as AccountSettings }
				),
			async save(_person, input, request) {
				audit.save++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<SettingsField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '此邮箱未通过应用规则' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示保存被拒绝，请修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: '账户设置已保存' };
				if (result.status === 'success') settings = { ...input };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async verifyRegistration(id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<RegistrationField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async verifySave(_subject, id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<SettingsField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async refreshDisplay(_subject, request) {
				audit.refresh++;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || controls.refreshFailure)
					throw new Error('Synthetic display failure');
				profileName = settings.displayName;
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		security,
		client,
		async identity(id: string | number) {
			currentId = id;
			await security.restore();
		},
		dispose() {
			audit.disposed = true;
			security.dispose();
			client.dispose();
		}
	};
}

import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';

/** Carry the actual host scope's ASAM/EP variables across a public body teleport.
 * No global theme writes and no duplicate token-generation algorithm. */
export function useScopedDialogStyle(origin: Ref<HTMLElement | undefined>, open: () => boolean) {
	const variables = shallowRef<Record<string, string>>({});
	let observer: MutationObserver | undefined;
	function collect() {
		if (!open() || !origin.value) return;
		const style = getComputedStyle(origin.value);
		variables.value = Object.fromEntries(
			Array.from(style)
				.filter((key) => key.startsWith('--asam-') || key.startsWith('--el-'))
				.map((key) => [key, style.getPropertyValue(key)])
		);
	}
	function stop() {
		observer?.disconnect();
		observer = undefined;
		window.removeEventListener('resize', collect);
	}
	watch(
		open,
		(value) => {
			stop();
			if (!value || !origin.value) return;
			collect();
			observer = new MutationObserver(collect);
			for (
				let node: HTMLElement | null = origin.value.parentElement;
				node;
				node = node.parentElement
			)
				observer.observe(node, {
					attributes: true,
					attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'data-color-mode']
				});
			window.addEventListener('resize', collect);
		},
		{ flush: 'post' }
	);
	onBeforeUnmount(stop);
	return variables;
}

type CompleteSettingsParameters = { [K in keyof typeof zh]: Record<never, never> };
export type CompleteSettingsLabel =
	keyof typeof zh extends `app.templates.settingsComplete.${infer Label}` ? Label : never;
declare module '@asam-ui/ui/i18n' {

}
export function useCompleteSettingsText() {
	const i18n = useAsamProI18n({ 'zh-CN': zh, en });
	return {
		i18n,
		t: (key: CompleteSettingsLabel) =>
			i18n.t(...([`app.templates.settingsComplete.${key}`] as Parameters<AsamI18n['t']>))
	};
}

<template>
	<span ref="origin" hidden aria-hidden="true"></span
	><AsamDialog
		:style="dialogStyle"
		:model-value="open"
		:title="t('leaveTitle')"
		width="min(440px, calc(100vw - 32px))"

		append-to-body
		@update:model-value="!$event && emit('cancel')"

			><AsamButton type="primary" :size="size" @click="emit('cancel')">{{
				t(unknown ? 'resolveFirst' : 'stay')

				type="primary"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamDialog, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { useScopedDialogStyle } from './DialogStyle.js';

	open: boolean;
	unknown: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
}>();
const origin = ref<HTMLElement>();
const dialogStyle = useScopedDialogStyle(origin, () => props.open);
const emit = defineEmits<{ cancel: []; leave: [] }>();
const { t } = useCompleteSettingsText();
</script>

	<component
		:is="inheritAppearance ? AsamConfigProvider : AsamApplicationProvider"
		v-bind="
			inheritAppearance
				? { size, i18n }
				: { config: { size, colorMode: dark ? 'dark' : 'light', base: { i18n } } }
		"
		><div class="settings-demo" :lang="i18n.locale.value">
			<!-- prettier-ignore --><Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"><section class="preview-control-group"><nav class="settings-demo-tools" :aria-label="t('service')"><label v-if="!externalI18n"><span>{{ t('language') }}</span><AsamSelect :model-value="i18n.locale.value" @update:model-value="setLocale"><AsamOption value="zh-CN" label="简体中文"  /><AsamOption value="en" label="English"  /></AsamSelect></label><label v-if="!inheritAppearance"><span>{{ t('theme') }}</span><AsamSelect :model-value="dark ? 'dark' : 'light'" @update:model-value="setTheme"><AsamOption value="light" :label="t('light')"  /><AsamOption value="dark" :label="t('dark')"  /></AsamSelect></label><label><span>{{ t('size') }}</span><AsamSelect :model-value="size" @update:model-value="setSize"><AsamOption
					v-for="item in sizes"
					:key="item"
					:value="item"
					:label="item"
				 /></AsamSelect></label><div class="preview-choice-field"><span><span>{{ t('service') }}</span></span><WebsiteAsamRadioGroup :model-value="fixture.controls.mode" @update:model-value="setMode" class="preview-choice-grid" :ariaLabel="''"><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="success" border>{{ t('success') }}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="failure" border>{{ t('failure') }}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="unknown" border>{{ t('unknown') }}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem></WebsiteAsamRadioGroup></div><AsamButton @click="switchIdentity" type="primary">{{ t('identity') }}</AsamButton><AsamButton @click="fixture.security.expire()" type="primary">{{ t('expire') }}</AsamButton><AsamButton @click="fixture.security.restore()" type="primary">{{ t('restore') }}</AsamButton></nav></section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider></Teleport
			><AsamAlert
				:title="t('demo')"
				type="info"
				:closable="false"
				class="settings-demo-notice"
			/>
			<p v-if="notice" class="settings-demo-feedback" role="status">
				{{ t('localFlow') }}{{ t(notice) }}
			</p>
			<WorkspaceSettings
				v-if="!destination"
				:host="fixture.host"
				:capabilities="capabilities"
				:size="size"
				@page="destination = $event"
			/><AsamCard
				v-else
				bordered
				:body-style="{ padding: '24px' }"
				class="settings-demo-destination"

				<AsamButton type="primary" @click="destination = undefined">{{
					t('backSettings')

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamAlert,
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamConfigProvider,
	AsamOption,
	AsamSelect
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AccountPage, AccountRequest } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsAction, AccountSettingsCapabilities } from './Types.js';
import { createAccountFixture } from '../examples/Fixture.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
import type { SettingsWorkspaceLabel } from './I18n.js';
import WorkspaceSettings from './WorkspaceSettings.vue';

const props = defineProps<{
	externalI18n?: AsamI18n;
	inheritAppearance?: boolean;
	onLocale?: (locale: 'en' | 'zh-CN') => void;
}>();
const { i18n, t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const fixture = createAccountFixture(i18n, {
	biography: '在团队中分享经验，共同完善工作空间。',
	officeArea: 'beijing'
});
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'] as const;
const size = shallowRef<(typeof sizes)[number]>('default');
const dark = shallowRef(false);
const destination = shallowRef<AccountPage>();
const notice = shallowRef<SettingsWorkspaceLabel>();
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') props.onLocale?.(value);
}
function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') dark.value = value === 'dark';
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}
function setMode(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'success' || value === 'failure' || value === 'unknown')
		fixture.controls.mode = value;
}
function switchIdentity() {
	const id = fixture.security.state.value.subject?.id;
	void fixture.identity(typeof id === 'number' ? '0' : 0);
}
const open =
	(key: SettingsWorkspaceLabel) => async (_subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest) => {
		if (request.isCurrent()) notice.value = key;
	};
const actionDefinitions = [
	{
		id: 'password',
		title: 'password',
		description: 'passwordDescription',
		open: open('password')
	},
	{ id: 'phone', title: 'phone', description: 'phoneDescription', open: open('phone') },
	{ id: 'email', title: 'email', description: 'emailDescription', open: open('email') },
	{
		id: 'organization',
		title: 'organization',
		description: 'organizationDescription',
		open: open('organization')
	},
	{
		id: 'workEmail',
		title: 'workEmail',
		description: 'workEmailDescription',
		open: open('workEmail')
	}
] as const;
async function saveAvatar(_file: File, _subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest) {
	if (!request.isCurrent()) return;
	if (fixture.controls.mode === 'failure') throw Error('本地合成头像失败');
	// 本地仅确认演示回执，不上传、不产生服务器未知写入。
	notice.value = 'avatarSaved';
}
const capabilities = computed<AccountSettingsCapabilities | undefined>(() => {
	const subject = fixture.security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject) return;
	const actions: AccountSettingsAction[] = actionDefinitions.map((item) => ({
		id: item.id,
		title: t(item.title),
		description: t(item.description),
		status: t('demoStatus'),
		actionLabel: t('manage'),
		rule: { permission: 'account:write', write: true },
		open: item.open
	}));
	return {
		owner: subject,
		profileFields: {
			biography: true,
			officeAreas: [
				{ value: 'beijing', label: t('officeBeijing') },
				{ value: 'shanghai', label: t('officeShanghai') }
			]
		},
		avatar: { initials: subject.name.slice(0, 1), save: saveAvatar },
		security: actions.slice(0, 3),
		bindings: actions.slice(3)
	};
});
onMounted(() => {
	void fixture.security.restore();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => fixture.dispose());
</script>

<style scoped>
.settings-demo {
	container-type: inline-size;
	min-height: 100%;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	line-height: 1.75;
}

.settings-demo-tools {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	max-width: 1180px;
	margin: 0 auto 20px;
}

.settings-demo-tools label {
	display: grid;
	min-width: 160px;
	gap: 4px;
}

.settings-demo-notice,
.settings-demo-feedback,
.settings-demo-destination {
	max-width: 1180px;
	margin: 0 auto 24px;
}

.settings-demo-destination {
	--asam-size-card-height: 0;
}

.settings-demo-destination h1 {
	line-height: 2;
}

@container (max-width: 520px) {
	.settings-demo-tools > * {
		width: 100%;
		margin: 0;
	}
}
</style>

	<section class="settings-actions" :aria-label="title">
		<h2>{{ title }}</h2>
		<AsamEmpty v-if="!owned || !items?.length" :description="t('noActions')" />
		<div v-for="item in owned ? items : []" :key="item.id" class="settings-action-row">
			<div>
				<h3>{{ item.title }}</h3>
				<p>{{ item.description }}</p>
				<p class="settings-action-state">{{ owned ? item.status : t('notConnected') }}</p>
			</div>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				plain
				:size="size"
				:disabled="!canOpen(item) || !!pending"
				:loading="pending === item.id"
				@click="open(item)"
				>{{ item.actionLabel }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}</p>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AccountHost } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsAction, AccountSettingsCapabilities } from './Types.js';
import { createAccountRequestScope } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	host: AccountHost;
	owner: AccountSettingsCapabilities['owner'];
	title: string;
	items?: readonly AccountSettingsAction[];
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
}>();
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const pending = shallowRef('');
const feedback = shallowRef<'opened' | 'actionFailed'>();
const owned = computed(() => {
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner)
	);
});
const scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, () => {
	pending.value = '';
	feedback.value = undefined;
});
const canOpen = (item: AccountSettingsAction) =>
	owned.value &&
	!props.disabled &&
	!props.readonly &&
	!!item.open &&
	props.host.security.check(item.rule) === 'allowed';
watch(
	() => [scopeKey(props.owner), props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => props.items,
	(items, previous) => {
		if (
			pending.value &&
			items?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open !==
				previous?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open
		)
			scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function open(item: AccountSettingsAction) {
	if (pending.value || !canOpen(item) || !item.open) return;
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	pending.value = item.id;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await item.open(subject, request);
		if (request.isCurrent() && canOpen(item)) feedback.value = 'opened';
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'actionFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = '';
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
</script>

<template>
	<aside class="settings-avatar" :aria-label="t('avatar')">
		<h2>{{ t('avatar') }}</h2>
		<AsamAvatar :size="88" :src="owned ? preview || safeAccountUrl(avatar?.src) : undefined">{{

			:disabled="blocked"
			:on-change="choose"
			><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamButton
				type="primary"
				plain
				:size="size"
				:disabled="blocked"
			>{{ t('changeAvatar') }}</AsamButton></AsamUpload
		>
		<p class="settings-avatar-hint">

				avatar?.previewOnly
					? completeText('avatarLocalHint')
					: t(avatar?.save ? 'avatarHint' : 'notConnected')

		</p>
		<div v-if="selected || validating" class="settings-avatar-actions">
			<AsamButton
				v-if="selected && avatar?.save && !avatar?.previewOnly"
				type="primary"
				:size="size"
				:loading="pending"
				:disabled="blocked || validating"
				@click="save"
				>{{ t('saveAvatar') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton type="primary" :size="size" :disabled="pending" @click="scope.clear()">{{
				t('cancelAvatar')
			}}</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}</p>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamAvatar, AsamButton, AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { UploadFile } from 'element-plus';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AccountHost } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsAvatar, AccountSettingsCapabilities } from './Types.js';
import { createAccountRequestScope, safeAccountUrl } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	host: AccountHost;
	owner: AccountSettingsCapabilities['owner'];
	validationKey?: string | number;
	avatar?: AccountSettingsAvatar;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ dirty: [value: boolean] }>();
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const upload = useTemplateRef<AsamNativeUploadExpose>('upload');
const selected = shallowRef<File>();
const preview = shallowRef('');
const pending = shallowRef(false);
const validating = shallowRef(false);
let decoding: { cancel(): void } | undefined;
function stopDecode() {
	const prior = decoding;
	decoding = undefined;
	validating.value = false;
	prior?.cancel();
}
const feedback = shallowRef<'avatarInvalid' | 'avatarSaved' | 'avatarFailed'>();
const owned = computed(() => {
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner) &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed'
	);
});
const allowed = computed(
	() =>
		owned.value &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed'
);
const blocked = computed(
	() =>
		props.disabled ||
		props.readonly ||
		pending.value ||
		!allowed.value ||
		(!props.avatar?.save && !props.avatar?.previewOnly)
);
function reset() {
	stopDecode();
	if (preview.value) URL.revokeObjectURL(preview.value);
	preview.value = '';
	selected.value = undefined;
	pending.value = false;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	emit('dirty', false);
}
let scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, reset);
watch(
	() => props.host,
	(host) => {
		scope.dispose();
		scope = createAccountRequestScope(host, reset);
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	[
		() => scopeKey(props.owner),
		() => props.avatar?.src,
		() => props.avatar?.save,
		() => props.avatar?.previewOnly
	],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, allowed.value, props.validationKey],
	() => {
		if (pending.value || validating.value) scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function choose(file: UploadFile) {
	if (blocked.value || !file.raw) return;
	upload.value?.clearFiles();
	stopDecode();
	const raw = file.raw;
	if (
		!['image/jpeg', 'image/png'].includes(raw.type) ||
		raw.size === 0 ||
		raw.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024
	) {
		feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
		return;
	}
	const host = props.host;
	// Local preview only: this lease never reaches an upload/save service.
	const request = scope.request('avatar-preview', true);
	let image: HTMLImageElement | undefined;
	let candidateUrl = '';
	let released = false;
	const operation = {
		cancel() {
			if (released) return;
			released = true;
			image?.removeAttribute('src');
			if (candidateUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(candidateUrl);
			candidateUrl = '';
			request.release();
		}
	};
	decoding = operation;
	validating.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	const current = () =>
		decoding === operation &&
		props.host === host &&
		request.isCurrent() &&
		!blocked.value &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed' &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed';
	try {
		image = new Image();
		candidateUrl = URL.createObjectURL(raw);
		image.src = candidateUrl;
		await image.decode();
		if (!current()) return;
		const prior = preview.value;
		selected.value = raw;
		preview.value = candidateUrl;
		candidateUrl = '';
		if (prior) URL.revokeObjectURL(prior);
		emit('dirty', true);
	} catch {
		if (current()) feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
	} finally {
		if (decoding === operation) {
			decoding = undefined;
			validating.value = false;
		}
		operation.cancel();
	}
}
async function save() {
	if (
		blocked.value ||
		validating.value ||
		!selected.value ||
		!props.avatar?.save ||
		props.avatar.previewOnly
	)
		return;
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	if (!state.subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	const file = selected.value;
	pending.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await props.avatar.save(file, state.subject, request);
		if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed.value || props.disabled || props.readonly) return;
		selected.value = undefined;
		feedback.value = 'avatarSaved';
		emit('dirty', false);
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'avatarFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = false;
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
defineExpose({ clear: () => scope.clear() });
</script>

<style scoped>

	display: grid;
	justify-items: center;
	align-content: start;

import type { SecurityRule, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AccountRequest } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsCompanion } from '../Session.js';

/** Optional full-page presentation/lifecycle composition, with the original save coordinator. */
export interface AccountSettingsComposition {
	readonly companion: AccountSettingsCompanion;
	readonly revision: string | number;
	readonly empty: boolean;
	readonly cancelledRead: boolean;
	cancel(): void;
}

/** 只承载安全投影与进入宿主流程的入口，不在模板中实现凭据或绑定操作。 */
export interface AccountSettingsAction {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description: string;
	readonly status: string;
	readonly actionLabel: string;
	readonly rule: SecurityRule;
	readonly open?: (subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest) => Promise<void>;
}

export interface AccountSettingsAvatar {
	/** Local selection/preview only; enables no upload or persistence service. */
	readonly previewOnly?: boolean;
	readonly src?: string;
	readonly initials?: string;
	/** 显式保存头像；宿主负责上传、持久化及副作用提交前的 isCurrent 核验。 */
	readonly save?: (
		file: File,
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		request: AccountRequest
	) => Promise<void>;
}

export interface AccountSettingsCapabilities {
	/** 显示投影的身份与租户/组织，必须与当前安全会话一致。 */
	readonly owner: Pick<SecuritySubject, 'id' | 'scope'>;
	/** 显式接入可选前端资料；宿主在已有 settings/save 边界映射自己的 DTO。 */
	readonly profileFields?: {
		readonly biography?: boolean;
		/** 只接受宿主给出的区域选项；省略时不显示此字段。 */
		readonly officeAreas?: readonly { readonly value: string; readonly label: string }[];
	};
	readonly avatar?: AccountSettingsAvatar;
	readonly security?: readonly AccountSettingsAction[];
	readonly bindings?: readonly AccountSettingsAction[];
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamCard } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SettingsPanel from '../shared/SettingsPanel.vue';
import type { AccountPageProps, AccountPageEvents, AccountPageExpose } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsCapabilities } from './Types.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps<AccountPageProps & { capabilities?: AccountSettingsCapabilities }>();
const emit = defineEmits<AccountPageEvents>();
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const panel = useTemplateRef<AccountPageExpose>('panel');
const workspace = computed(
	() =>
		props.capabilities ??
		(props.host.security.state.value.subject
			? { owner: props.host.security.state.value.subject }
			: undefined)
);
defineExpose({ clear: () => panel.value?.clear() });
</script>

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';

/** 示例宿主拥有安全与模拟服务；外部语言实例仍归调用者。 */
export function mountWorkspaceSettings(
	element: Element,
	host?: { i18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean },
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'workspace-settings-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

	<section
		ref="panel"

			><AsamButton

					completeText(data.saveStatus.value === 'pending' ? 'stopWaiting' : 'cancelRead')

			>
		</div>
		<p v-if="!data.allowed()" role="status">
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.settingsDenied') }}
		</p>
		<div
			v-else
			:class="{
				'settings-workspace-content': workspace,
				'settings-workspace-columns': desktopTabs
			}"
		>
			<AsamTabs
				v-if="workspace"
				class="settings-workspace-tabs"
				:model-value="tab"
				:items="tabs"
				:tab-position="desktopTabs ? 'left' : 'top'"
				@update:model-value="setTab"
			/><SettingsActions
				v-if="workspace"
				v-show="tab === 'security'"
				:host="host"
				:owner="workspace.owner"
				:items="workspace.security"
				:title="t('security')"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:readonly="readonly"
				:size="size"
			/><SettingsActions
				v-if="workspace"
				v-show="tab === 'bindings'"
				:host="host"
				:owner="workspace.owner"
				:items="workspace.bindings"
				:title="t('bindings')"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:readonly="readonly"
				:size="size"
			/>
			<p v-if="data.settingsStatus.value === 'loading'" role="status">
				{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.settingsLoading') }}

			<p
				v-if="
					data.settingsStatus.value === 'error' &&
					!composition?.empty &&
					!composition?.cancelledRead

				role="alert"
			>
				{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.settingsFailed') }}
			</p>
			<AsamEmpty v-if="composition?.empty" :description="completeText('empty')" />
			<p v-if="composition?.cancelledRead" role="status">
				{{ completeText('cancelledRead') }}
			</p>
			<p v-if="readonly || !data.allowed(true)" role="status">
				{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.readonly') }}
			</p>
			<AsamForm
				v-if="data.settingsStatus.value === 'ready'"
				v-show="!composition || tab === 'basic' || tab === 'notifications'"
				:model-value="data.draft"
				:inline="false"
				:show-search="false"
				:show-reset="false"
				:label-position="workspace ? 'top' : undefined"
				:size="size"
				@search="save"
				><div
					v-show="!workspace || tab === 'basic'"
					:class="{ 'settings-workspace-profile': workspace }"
				>
					<SettingsAvatar
						v-if="workspace"
						ref="avatarPanel"
						class="settings-workspace-avatar"
						:host="host"
						:owner="workspace.owner"
						:validation-key="composition?.revision"
						:avatar="workspace.avatar"
						:disabled="locked || !writable"
						:readonly="readonly"
						:size="size"
						@dirty="avatarDirty = $event"
					/>
					<div class="settings-workspace-fields">
						<slot
							name="fields"
							:draft="data.draft"
							:errors="data.displayErrors.value"
							:locked="locked"
							:writable="writable"
							:update="updateField"
							:set-language="setLanguage"
							:set-office="setOfficeArea"
							><AsamFormItem
								v-for="field in textFields"
								:key="field.key"
								:prop="field.key"
								:label="field.label"
								:error="data.displayErrors.value[field.key]"
								><AsamInput
									:model-value="data.draft[field.key]"
									:name="field.key"
									:autocomplete="field.autocomplete"
									:style="workspace ? { width: '100%' } : undefined"
									:size="size"
									:readonly="!writable"
									:disabled="locked"
									@update:model-value="
										data.draft[field.key] = String($event)
									" /></AsamFormItem
							><AsamFormItem
								:label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.language')"
								prop="language"
								:error="data.displayErrors.value.language"
								><AsamSelect
									:model-value="data.draft.language"
									class="account-select"
									:disabled="locked || !writable"
									:style="{
										minHeight: heights[size],
										...(workspace ? { width: '100%' } : {})
									}"
									:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.language')"
									@update:model-value="setLanguage"
									><AsamOption
										v-for="item in languages"
										:key="item.value"
										:label="String(item.label).trim()"
										:value="item.value"
										>{{ item.label }}</AsamOption
									></AsamSelect
								></AsamFormItem
							><AsamFormItem
								v-if="profileFields?.biography"
								prop="biography"
								:label="t('biography')"
								:error="data.displayErrors.value.biography"
								><AsamTextarea
									:model-value="data.draft.biography ?? ''"
									name="biography"
									:rows="3"
									:size="size"
									:readonly="!writable"
									:disabled="locked"
									style="width: 100%"
									@update:model-value="
										data.draft.biography = String($event)
									" /></AsamFormItem
							><AsamFormItem
								v-if="profileFields?.officeAreas"
								prop="officeArea"
								:label="t('officeArea')"
								:error="data.displayErrors.value.officeArea"
								><AsamSelect
									:model-value="data.draft.officeArea ?? ''"
									name="officeArea"
									:aria-label="t('officeArea')"
									:size="size"
									:disabled="locked || !writable"
									style="width: 100%"
									clearable
									@update:model-value="setOfficeArea"
									><AsamOption
										v-for="option in profileFields.officeAreas"
										:key="option.value"
										:value="option.value"
										:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></AsamFormItem
						></slot>
					</div>
				</div>
				<slot
					v-if="$slots.notifications"
					name="notifications"
					:active="tab === 'notifications'"
					:draft="data.draft"
					:locked="locked"
					:writable="writable"
					:save-notification="saveNotification"
				/><AsamFormItem
					v-if="!$slots.notifications"
					v-show="!workspace || tab === 'notifications'"
					:label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.notifications')"
					prop="notifications"
					><!-- prettier-ignore --><label class="account-consent"><AsamCheckboxItem
						:model-value="data.draft.notifications"
						:disabled="locked || !writable"
						@update:model-value="data.draft.notifications = $event === true"
					 />{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.receiveNotifications') }}</label></AsamFormItem
				><AsamFormItem
					v-if="!$slots.notifications"
					v-show="!workspace || tab === 'notifications'"
					:label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.digest')"
					prop="digest"
					><!-- prettier-ignore --><label class="account-consent"><AsamCheckboxItem
						:model-value="data.draft.digest"
						:disabled="locked || !writable"
						@update:model-value="data.draft.digest = $event === true"
					 />{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.receiveDigest') }}</label></AsamFormItem
				>
				<p role="status">
					{{
						data.dirty.value
							? i18n.t('app.templates.account.dirty')
							: i18n.t('app.templates.account.clean')
					}}
				</p>
				<div class="account-actions">
					<AsamButton
						class="account-message-button"
						type="primary"
						native-type="submit"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked || !writable || !data.dirty.value"
						>{{
							data.saveStatus.value === 'pending'
								? i18n.t('app.templates.account.saving')
								: composition
									? completeText('saveLocal')
									: i18n.t('app.templates.account.save')
						}}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked || !writable || !data.dirty.value"
						@click="data.revert(!writable || disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.revert') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></AsamForm
			>
			<div
				ref="result"
				tabindex="-1"
				class="account-result"
				aria-live="polite"
				:role="
					['failure', 'unknown', 'field-error'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)
						? 'alert'
						: 'status'
				"
			>
				<p v-for="(error, field) in data.displayErrors.value" :key="field">{{ error }}</p>
				<p>{{ data.displayMessage.value }}</p>
				<template v-if="data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown'"
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.services.verifySave"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="completeSave('verify')"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.verifySave') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.resolveUnknown"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="host.resolveUnknown('save', data.operationId.value)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.resolve') }}</AsamButton
					></template
				><template
					v-if="data.saveStatus.value === 'success' && host.services.refreshDisplay"
					><p v-if="data.displayStatus.value === 'error'" role="alert">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayFailed') }}
					</p>
					<p v-if="data.displayStatus.value === 'success'">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayUpdated') }}
					</p>
					<AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || data.displayStatus.value === 'pending'"
						@click="data.refreshDisplay(disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.refreshDisplay') }}</AsamButton
					></template
				>
			</div>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				v-if="data.settingsStatus.value === 'error' || data.settingsStatus.value === 'idle'"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="data.loadSettings(disabled)"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.reloadSettings') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<div class="account-actions">
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="
					disabled ||
					data.saveStatus.value === 'pending' ||
					(!!composition && !data.allowed())
				"
				@click="leave"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.backProfile') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<LeaveDialog
			v-if="composition"
			:open="confirmLeave"
			:unknown="data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown'"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:size="size"
			@cancel="confirmLeave = false"
			@leave="discardAndLeave"
		/>
		<div v-if="confirmLeave && !composition" class="account-leave" role="alert">
			<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.leaveWarning') }}</p>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="confirmLeave = false"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.continueEditing') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="emit('page', 'profile')"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.leave') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamTabs, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SettingsAvatar from '../settings/SettingsAvatar.vue';
import SettingsActions from '../settings/SettingsActions.vue';
import LeaveDialog from '../settings-complete/LeaveDialog.vue';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';
import type { AccountSettingsCapabilities, AccountSettingsComposition } from '../settings/Types.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from '../settings/I18n.js';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamForm, AsamFormItem, AsamInput, AsamTextarea } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAccountData } from '../Session.js';
import type { NotificationChange } from '../Session.js';
import type { AccountPageEvents, AccountPageProps } from '../Types.js';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<
		AccountPageProps & {
			title: string;
			workspace?: AccountSettingsCapabilities;
			composition?: AccountSettingsComposition;
		}
	>(),
	{
		size: 'default',
		workspace: undefined,
		composition: undefined
	}
);
const emit = defineEmits<AccountPageEvents>();
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const tab = ref<'basic' | 'security' | 'bindings' | 'notifications'>('basic');
const tabs = computed(() =>
	['basic', 'security', 'bindings', 'notifications'].map((value) => ({
		value,
		label: t(value as 'basic' | 'security' | 'bindings' | 'notifications')
	}))
);
function setTab(value: unknown) {
	if (
		value === 'basic' ||
		value === 'security' ||
		value === 'bindings' ||
		value === 'notifications'
	)
		tab.value = value;
}
const avatarPanel = ref<{ clear(): void }>();
const panel = ref<HTMLElement>();
const desktopTabs = ref(false);
let panelObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const avatarDirty = ref(false);
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n, props.composition?.companion);
const profileFields = computed(() => {
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	return subject && props.workspace && scopeKey(subject) === scopeKey(props.workspace.owner)
		? props.workspace.profileFields
		: undefined;
});
function setOfficeArea(value: unknown) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') data.draft.officeArea = '';
	else if (
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		profileFields.value?.officeAreas?.some((item) => item.value === value)
	)
		data.draft.officeArea = value;
}
const result = ref<HTMLElement>();
const confirmLeave = ref(false);
let disposed = false;
let completedOperation = '';
const writable = computed(() => !props.readonly && data.allowed(true));
const locked = computed(
	() => props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)
);
const languages = computed(
	() =>
		props.host.languages ?? [
			{ value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
			{ value: 'en', label: 'English' }
		]
);
const heights = { small: '28px', default: '32px', big: '36px', large: '40px' };
function setLanguage(value: unknown) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (typeof value === 'string' && languages.value.some((item) => item.value === value))
		data.draft.language = value;
}
const textFields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		},
		autocomplete: 'nickname'
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		},
		autocomplete: 'email'
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		},
		autocomplete: 'tel'
	}
] as const;
function updateField(field: string, value: unknown) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') data.draft[field] = value === true;
	else if (field === 'displayName' || field === 'email' || field === 'biography')
		data.draft[field] = String(value);
}
function discardAndLeave() {
	if (props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)) return;
	data.revert();
	avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	confirmLeave.value = false;
	emit('page', 'profile');
}
function beforeUnload(event: BeforeUnloadEvent) {
	if (
		props.composition &&
		(data.dirty.value ||
			avatarDirty.value ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value))
	) {
		event.preventDefault();
		event.returnValue = '';
	}
}
onMounted(() => {
	if (!props.composition) return;
	window.addEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	if (panel.value) {
		panelObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
			desktopTabs.value = !!entry && entry.contentRect.width >= 900;
		});
		panelObserver.observe(panel.value);
	}
});
async function save() {
	await completeSave('save');
}
async function completeSave(action: 'save' | 'verify') {
	await finishSave(data[action](props.disabled || (action === 'save' && !writable.value)));
}
async function saveNotification(field: NotificationChange['field'], value: boolean) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	await finishSave(data.save(false, { field, value }), false);
}
async function finishSave(pending: Promise<boolean>, focus = true) {
	const operation = data.operationId.value;
	const accepted = await pending;
	await nextTick();
	if (!disposed && operation === data.operationId.value) {
		if (focus) result.value?.focus();
		if (
			accepted &&
			operation &&
			operation !== completedOperation &&
			data.saveStatus.value === 'success'
		) {
			completedOperation = operation;
			emit('completed', 'save');
		}
	}
}
function leave() {
	if (data.dirty.value || avatarDirty.value || data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown')
		confirmLeave.value = true;
	else emit('page', 'profile');
}
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.composition?.revision],
	() => {
		confirmLeave.value = false;
		if (props.composition && !data.allowed()) {
			data.clear();
			avatarPanel.value?.clear();
		}
		void data.loadSettings(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	panelObserver?.disconnect();
	window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	data.dispose();
});
defineExpose({
	clear: () => {
		data.clear();
		avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	}
});
</script>

.account-settings-workspace .account-intro {
	margin: 4px 0 24px;

.settings-workspace-profile {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(240px, 1fr);
	grid-template-areas: 'fields avatar';
	gap: clamp(32px, 4vw, 64px);
	padding-block: 24px;
}

.settings-workspace-profile > .settings-workspace-fields {
	grid-area: fields;
	min-width: 0;
}

.settings-workspace-avatar {
	grid-area: avatar;
	min-width: 0;
	padding-inline: var(--asam-space-lg);
	border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}

/* stylelint-disable-next-line selector-class-pattern -- Element Plus 公开结构类。 */
.account-settings-workspace :deep(.el-form-item__label) {
	line-height: 1.75;
}

.account-settings-workspace .account-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 12px;
	margin-block: 20px;
}

.account-settings-workspace .account-actions :deep(.el-button) {
	margin-left: 0;
}

.account-settings-workspace .account-leave {
	padding: 20px;
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-warning);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-container, 8px);
}

@container (width < 740px) {
	.settings-workspace-profile {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		grid-template-areas:
			'avatar'
			'fields';
		gap: 32px;
	}

	.settings-workspace-avatar {
		padding-inline: 0;
		padding-block-end: var(--asam-space-lg);
		border-inline-start: 0;
		border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.account-settings-workspace :deep(*) {
		animation-duration: 0s;
		transition-duration: 0s;
	}
}

	return {

		organization: text(value.organization),

		const url = new URL(value);

	} catch {

	}
}

		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		language: text(value.language),
		notifications: value.notifications === true,
		digest: value.digest === true,
		...(typeof value.biography === 'string' ? { biography: value.biography } : {}),

function feedback(owner) {
	const scope = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, accountMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const message = ref('');

	const sources = shallowRef({});
	const errors = ref({});

	}
	return {
		message,
		errors,
		sources,
		setMessage,
		displayMessage: computed(() =>
			scope && source.value ? formatFieldIssue(source.value, scope) : message.value

		displayErrors: computed(() =>
			Object.fromEntries(

		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);

		add(
			'account',

			'app.templates.account.accountInvalid'
		);

		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.password.length < (host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8))
		add(
			'password',
			`密码至少${host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8}位`,

		add('displayName', '显示名需为1至60个字符', 'app.templates.account.nameInvalid');

		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');

		add('phone', '请填写有效联系电话或留空', 'app.templates.account.phoneInvalid');

		save: 0,

		refresh: 0,

		language: 'zh-CN',

		scope: { tenant: 0, organization: 0 },
		contexts: [

import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
/** Carry the actual host scope's ASAM/EP variables across a public body teleport.
 * No global theme writes and no duplicate token-generation algorithm. */
export function useScopedDialogStyle(origin, open) {
	const variables = shallowRef({});
	let observer;
	function collect() {
		if (!open() || !origin.value) return;
		const style = getComputedStyle(origin.value);
		variables.value = Object.fromEntries(
			Array.from(style)
				.filter((key) => key.startsWith('--asam-') || key.startsWith('--el-'))
				.map((key) => [key, style.getPropertyValue(key)])
		);
	}
	function stop() {
		observer?.disconnect();
		observer = undefined;
		window.removeEventListener('resize', collect);
	}
	watch(
		open,
		(value) => {
			stop();
			if (!value || !origin.value) return;
			collect();
			observer = new MutationObserver(collect);
			for (let node = origin.value.parentElement; node; node = node.parentElement)
				observer.observe(node, {
					attributes: true,
					attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'data-color-mode']
				});
			window.addEventListener('resize', collect);
		},
		{ flush: 'post' }
	);
	onBeforeUnmount(stop);
	return variables;
}

<template>
	<component
		:is="inheritAppearance ? AsamConfigProvider : AsamApplicationProvider"
		v-bind="
			inheritAppearance
				? { size, i18n }
				: { config: { size, colorMode: dark ? 'dark' : 'light', base: { i18n } } }
		"
		><div class="settings-demo" :lang="i18n.locale.value">
			<!-- prettier-ignore --><Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"><section class="preview-control-group"><nav class="settings-demo-tools" :aria-label="t('service')"><label v-if="!externalI18n"><span>{{ t('language') }}</span><AsamSelect :model-value="i18n.locale.value" @update:model-value="setLocale"><AsamOption value="zh-CN" label="简体中文"  /><AsamOption value="en" label="English"  /></AsamSelect></label><label v-if="!inheritAppearance"><span>{{ t('theme') }}</span><AsamSelect :model-value="dark ? 'dark' : 'light'" @update:model-value="setTheme"><AsamOption value="light" :label="t('light')"  /><AsamOption value="dark" :label="t('dark')"  /></AsamSelect></label><label><span>{{ t('size') }}</span><AsamSelect :model-value="size" @update:model-value="setSize"><AsamOption
					v-for="item in sizes"
					:key="item"
					:value="item"
					:label="item"
				 /></AsamSelect></label><div class="preview-choice-field"><span><span>{{ t('service') }}</span></span><WebsiteAsamRadioGroup :model-value="fixture.controls.mode" @update:model-value="setMode" class="preview-choice-grid" :ariaLabel="''"><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="success" border>{{ t('success') }}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="failure" border>{{ t('failure') }}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="unknown" border>{{ t('unknown') }}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem></WebsiteAsamRadioGroup></div><AsamButton @click="switchIdentity" type="primary">{{ t('identity') }}</AsamButton><AsamButton @click="fixture.security.expire()" type="primary">{{ t('expire') }}</AsamButton><AsamButton @click="fixture.security.restore()" type="primary">{{ t('restore') }}</AsamButton></nav></section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider></Teleport
			><AsamAlert
				:title="t('demo')"
				type="info"
				:closable="false"
				class="settings-demo-notice"

				{{ t('localFlow') }}{{ t(notice) }}
