<script setup>
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamAlert,
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamConfigProvider,
	AsamOption,
	AsamSelect
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createAccountFixture } from '../examples/Fixture.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
import WorkspaceSettings from './WorkspaceSettings.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	externalI18n: { type: Object, required: false },
	inheritAppearance: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	onLocale: { type: Function, required: false }
});
const { i18n, t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const fixture = createAccountFixture(i18n, {
	biography: '在团队中分享经验，共同完善工作空间。',
	officeArea: 'beijing'
});
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const size = shallowRef('default');
const dark = shallowRef(false);
const destination = shallowRef();
const notice = shallowRef();
function setLocale(value) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') props.onLocale?.(value);
}
function setTheme(value) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') dark.value = value === 'dark';
}
function setSize(value) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}
function setMode(value) {
	if (value === 'success' || value === 'failure' || value === 'unknown')
		fixture.controls.mode = value;
}
function switchIdentity() {
	const id = fixture.security.state.value.subject?.id;
	void fixture.identity(typeof id === 'number' ? '0' : 0);
}
const open = (key) => async (_subject, request) => {
	if (request.isCurrent()) notice.value = key;
};
const actionDefinitions = [
	{
		id: 'password',
		title: 'password',
		description: 'passwordDescription',
		open: open('password')
	},
	{ id: 'phone', title: 'phone', description: 'phoneDescription', open: open('phone') },
	{ id: 'email', title: 'email', description: 'emailDescription', open: open('email') },
	{
		id: 'organization',
		title: 'organization',
		description: 'organizationDescription',
		open: open('organization')
	},
	{
		id: 'workEmail',
		title: 'workEmail',
		description: 'workEmailDescription',
		open: open('workEmail')
	}
];
async function saveAvatar(_file, _subject, request) {
	if (!request.isCurrent()) return;
	if (fixture.controls.mode === 'failure') throw Error('本地合成头像失败');
	// 本地仅确认演示回执，不上传、不产生服务器未知写入。
	notice.value = 'avatarSaved';
}
const capabilities = computed(() => {
	const subject = fixture.security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject) return;
	const actions = actionDefinitions.map((item) => ({
		id: item.id,
		title: t(item.title),
		description: t(item.description),
		status: t('demoStatus'),
		actionLabel: t('manage'),
		rule: { permission: 'account:write', write: true },
		open: item.open
	}));
	return {
		owner: subject,
		profileFields: {
			biography: true,
			officeAreas: [
				{ value: 'beijing', label: t('officeBeijing') },
				{ value: 'shanghai', label: t('officeShanghai') }
			]
		},
		avatar: { initials: subject.name.slice(0, 1), save: saveAvatar },
		security: actions.slice(0, 3),
		bindings: actions.slice(3)
	};
});
onMounted(() => {
	void fixture.security.restore();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => fixture.dispose());
</script>

<style scoped>
.settings-demo {
	container-type: inline-size;
	min-height: 100%;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	line-height: 1.75;
}

.settings-demo-tools {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	max-width: 1180px;
	margin: 0 auto 20px;
}

.settings-demo-tools label {
	display: grid;
	min-width: 160px;
	gap: 4px;
}

.settings-demo-notice,
.settings-demo-feedback,
.settings-demo-destination {
	max-width: 1180px;
	margin: 0 auto 24px;
}

.settings-demo-destination {
	--asam-size-card-height: 0;
}

.settings-demo-destination h1 {
	line-height: 2;
}

@container (max-width: 520px) {
	.settings-demo-tools > * {
		width: 100%;
		margin: 0;
	}
}
</style>

		<AsamEmpty v-if="!owned || !items?.length" :description="t('noActions')" />
		<div v-for="item in owned ? items : []" :key="item.id" class="settings-action-row">
			<div>
				<h3>{{ item.title }}</h3>
				<p>{{ item.description }}</p>
				<p class="settings-action-state">{{ owned ? item.status : t('notConnected') }}</p>
			</div>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				plain
				:size="size"
				:disabled="!canOpen(item) || !!pending"
				:loading="pending === item.id"
				@click="open(item)"
				>{{ item.actionLabel }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}</p>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createAccountRequestScope } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	owner: { type: Object, required: true },
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	items: { type: Array, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const pending = shallowRef('');
const feedback = shallowRef();
const owned = computed(() => {
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner)
	);
});
const scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, () => {
	pending.value = '';
	feedback.value = undefined;
});
const canOpen = (item) =>
	owned.value &&
	!props.disabled &&
	!props.readonly &&
	!!item.open &&
	props.host.security.check(item.rule) === 'allowed';
watch(
	() => [scopeKey(props.owner), props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => props.items,
	(items, previous) => {
		if (
			pending.value &&
			items?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open !==
				previous?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open
		)
			scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function open(item) {
	if (pending.value || !canOpen(item) || !item.open) return;
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	pending.value = item.id;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await item.open(subject, request);
		if (request.isCurrent() && canOpen(item)) feedback.value = 'opened';
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'actionFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = '';
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
</script>

	<aside class="settings-avatar" :aria-label="t('avatar')">

			accept="image/png,image/jpeg"
			:disabled="blocked"
			:on-change="choose"
			><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamButton
				type="primary"
				plain
				:size="size"
				:disabled="blocked"
			>{{ t('changeAvatar') }}</AsamButton></AsamUpload
		>
		<p class="settings-avatar-hint">

					? completeText('avatarLocalHint')

				v-if="selected && avatar?.save && !avatar?.previewOnly"
				type="primary"

				:disabled="blocked || validating"
				@click="save"
				>{{ t('saveAvatar') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton type="primary" :size="size" :disabled="pending" @click="scope.clear()">{{
				t('cancelAvatar')
			}}</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}</p>

<script setup>
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamAvatar, AsamButton, AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createAccountRequestScope, safeAccountUrl } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	owner: { type: Object, required: true },
	validationKey: { type: [String, Number], required: false },
	avatar: { type: Object, required: false },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['dirty']);
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const upload = useTemplateRef('upload');
const selected = shallowRef();
const preview = shallowRef('');
const pending = shallowRef(false);
const validating = shallowRef(false);
let decoding;
function stopDecode() {
	const prior = decoding;
	decoding = undefined;
	validating.value = false;
	prior?.cancel();
}
const feedback = shallowRef();
const owned = computed(() => {
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner) &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed'
	);
});
const allowed = computed(
	() =>
		owned.value &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed'
);
const blocked = computed(
	() =>
		props.disabled ||
		props.readonly ||
		pending.value ||
		!allowed.value ||
		(!props.avatar?.save && !props.avatar?.previewOnly)
);
function reset() {
	stopDecode();
	if (preview.value) URL.revokeObjectURL(preview.value);
	preview.value = '';
	selected.value = undefined;
	pending.value = false;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	emit('dirty', false);
}
let scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, reset);
watch(
	() => props.host,
	(host) => {
		scope.dispose();
		scope = createAccountRequestScope(host, reset);
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	[
		() => scopeKey(props.owner),
		() => props.avatar?.src,
		() => props.avatar?.save,
		() => props.avatar?.previewOnly
	],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, allowed.value, props.validationKey],
	() => {
		if (pending.value || validating.value) scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function choose(file) {
	if (blocked.value || !file.raw) return;
	upload.value?.clearFiles();
	stopDecode();
	const raw = file.raw;
	if (
		!['image/jpeg', 'image/png'].includes(raw.type) ||
		raw.size === 0 ||
		raw.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024
	) {
		feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
		return;
	}
	const host = props.host;
	// Local preview only: this lease never reaches an upload/save service.
	const request = scope.request('avatar-preview', true);
	let image;
	let candidateUrl = '';
	let released = false;
	const operation = {
		cancel() {
			if (released) return;
			released = true;
			image?.removeAttribute('src');
			if (candidateUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(candidateUrl);
			candidateUrl = '';
			request.release();
		}
	};
	decoding = operation;
	validating.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	const current = () =>
		decoding === operation &&
		props.host === host &&
		request.isCurrent() &&
		!blocked.value &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed' &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed';
	try {
		image = new Image();
		candidateUrl = URL.createObjectURL(raw);
		image.src = candidateUrl;
		await image.decode();
		if (!current()) return;
		const prior = preview.value;
		selected.value = raw;
		preview.value = candidateUrl;
		candidateUrl = '';
		if (prior) URL.revokeObjectURL(prior);
		emit('dirty', true);
	} catch {
		if (current()) feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
	} finally {
		if (decoding === operation) {
			decoding = undefined;
			validating.value = false;
		}
		operation.cancel();
	}
}
async function save() {
	if (
		blocked.value ||
		validating.value ||
		!selected.value ||
		!props.avatar?.save ||
		props.avatar.previewOnly
	)
		return;
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	if (!state.subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	const file = selected.value;
	pending.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await props.avatar.save(file, state.subject, request);
		if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed.value || props.disabled || props.readonly) return;
		selected.value = undefined;
		feedback.value = 'avatarSaved';
		emit('dirty', false);
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'avatarFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = false;
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
defineExpose({ clear: () => scope.clear() });
</script>

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
/** 示例宿主拥有安全与模拟服务；外部语言实例仍归调用者。 */
export function mountWorkspaceSettings(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'workspace-settings-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

						native-type="submit"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked || !writable || !data.dirty.value"
						>{{
							data.saveStatus.value === 'pending'
								? i18n.t('app.templates.account.saving')
								: composition
									? completeText('saveLocal')
									: i18n.t('app.templates.account.save')
						}}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked || !writable || !data.dirty.value"
						@click="data.revert(!writable || disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.revert') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></AsamForm
			>
			<div
				ref="result"
				tabindex="-1"
				class="account-result"
				aria-live="polite"
				:role="
					['failure', 'unknown', 'field-error'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)
						? 'alert'
						: 'status'
				"
			>
				<p v-for="(error, field) in data.displayErrors.value" :key="field">{{ error }}</p>
				<p>{{ data.displayMessage.value }}</p>
				<template v-if="data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown'"
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.services.verifySave"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="completeSave('verify')"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.verifySave') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.resolveUnknown"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="host.resolveUnknown('save', data.operationId.value)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.resolve') }}</AsamButton
					></template
				><template
					v-if="data.saveStatus.value === 'success' && host.services.refreshDisplay"
					><p v-if="data.displayStatus.value === 'error'" role="alert">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayFailed') }}
					</p>
					<p v-if="data.displayStatus.value === 'success'">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayUpdated') }}
					</p>
					<AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || data.displayStatus.value === 'pending'"
						@click="data.refreshDisplay(disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.refreshDisplay') }}</AsamButton
					></template
				>
			</div>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				v-if="data.settingsStatus.value === 'error' || data.settingsStatus.value === 'idle'"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="data.loadSettings(disabled)"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.reloadSettings') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<div class="account-actions">
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="
					disabled ||
					data.saveStatus.value === 'pending' ||
					(!!composition && !data.allowed())
				"
				@click="leave"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.backProfile') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<LeaveDialog
			v-if="composition"
			:open="confirmLeave"
			:unknown="data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown'"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:size="size"
			@cancel="confirmLeave = false"
			@leave="discardAndLeave"
		/>
		<div v-if="confirmLeave && !composition" class="account-leave" role="alert">
			<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.leaveWarning') }}</p>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="confirmLeave = false"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.continueEditing') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="emit('page', 'profile')"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.leave') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamTabs, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SettingsAvatar from '../settings/SettingsAvatar.vue';
import SettingsActions from '../settings/SettingsActions.vue';
import LeaveDialog from '../settings-complete/LeaveDialog.vue';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from '../settings/I18n.js';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamForm, AsamFormItem, AsamInput, AsamTextarea } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAccountData } from '../Session.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	brand: { type: String, required: false },
	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	returnPath: { type: null, required: false },
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	workspace: { type: Object, required: false, default: undefined },
	composition: { type: Object, required: false, default: undefined }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['page', 'completed']);
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const tab = ref('basic');
const tabs = computed(() =>
	['basic', 'security', 'bindings', 'notifications'].map((value) => ({
		value,
		label: t(value)
	}))
);
function setTab(value) {
	if (
		value === 'basic' ||
		value === 'security' ||
		value === 'bindings' ||
		value === 'notifications'
	)
		tab.value = value;
}
const avatarPanel = ref();
const panel = ref();
const desktopTabs = ref(false);
let panelObserver;
const avatarDirty = ref(false);
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n, props.composition?.companion);
const profileFields = computed(() => {
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	return subject && props.workspace && scopeKey(subject) === scopeKey(props.workspace.owner)
		? props.workspace.profileFields
		: undefined;
});
function setOfficeArea(value) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') data.draft.officeArea = '';
	else if (
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		profileFields.value?.officeAreas?.some((item) => item.value === value)
	)
		data.draft.officeArea = value;
}
const result = ref();
const confirmLeave = ref(false);
let disposed = false;
let completedOperation = '';
const writable = computed(() => !props.readonly && data.allowed(true));
const locked = computed(
	() => props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)
);
const languages = computed(
	() =>
		props.host.languages ?? [
			{ value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
			{ value: 'en', label: 'English' }
		]
);
const heights = { small: '28px', default: '32px', big: '36px', large: '40px' };
function setLanguage(value) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (typeof value === 'string' && languages.value.some((item) => item.value === value))
		data.draft.language = value;
}
const textFields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		},
		autocomplete: 'nickname'
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		},
		autocomplete: 'email'
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		},
		autocomplete: 'tel'
	}
];
function updateField(field, value) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') data.draft[field] = value === true;
	else if (field === 'displayName' || field === 'email' || field === 'biography')
		data.draft[field] = String(value);
}
function discardAndLeave() {
	if (props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)) return;
	data.revert();
	avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	confirmLeave.value = false;
	emit('page', 'profile');
}
function beforeUnload(event) {
	if (
		props.composition &&
		(data.dirty.value ||
			avatarDirty.value ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value))
	) {
		event.preventDefault();
		event.returnValue = '';
	}
}
onMounted(() => {
	if (!props.composition) return;
	window.addEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	if (panel.value) {
		panelObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
			desktopTabs.value = !!entry && entry.contentRect.width >= 900;
		});
		panelObserver.observe(panel.value);
	}
});
async function save() {
	await completeSave('save');
}
async function completeSave(action) {
	await finishSave(data[action](props.disabled || (action === 'save' && !writable.value)));
}
async function saveNotification(field, value) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	await finishSave(data.save(false, { field, value }), false);
}
async function finishSave(pending, focus = true) {
	const operation = data.operationId.value;
	const accepted = await pending;
	await nextTick();
	if (!disposed && operation === data.operationId.value) {
		if (focus) result.value?.focus();
		if (
			accepted &&
			operation &&
			operation !== completedOperation &&
			data.saveStatus.value === 'success'
		) {
			completedOperation = operation;
			emit('completed', 'save');
		}
	}
}
function leave() {
	if (data.dirty.value || avatarDirty.value || data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown')
		confirmLeave.value = true;
	else emit('page', 'profile');
}
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.composition?.revision],
	() => {
		confirmLeave.value = false;
		if (props.composition && !data.allowed()) {
			data.clear();
			avatarPanel.value?.clear();
		}
		void data.loadSettings(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	panelObserver?.disconnect();
	window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	data.dispose();
});
defineExpose({
	clear: () => {
		data.clear();
		avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	}
});
</script>

			'fields';
		gap: 32px;
	}

	.settings-workspace-avatar {

在同一设置工作区管理基本资料与通知偏好，按宿主授权进入安全和账号绑定流程。页面真实复用ASAM组件，资料保存、撤回、离开确认与未知结果核实沿用原账户模板协议。

四个设置分区

基本资料使用流式表单与头像侧栏，窄容器自动堆叠；安全与绑定只展示宿主当前身份的投影和可用入口；通知与基本资料共享同一草稿，切换分区不会丢失修改。

接入与资源归属

复制 WorkspaceSettings.vue 及配套账户模板文件，传入 AccountHost。可选 capabilities 必须带 owner；头像和动作回调只属于该身份及租户/组织。宿主负责真实接口、权限和副作用前的 isCurrent 核验。模板不接管密码、短信、绑定或上传服务。

头像选择只预览，保存才调用宿主；未保存头像也进入离开确认。身份失效、替换与卸载取消本页请求并释放对象URL。原资料未知写入先核实，不自动重复保存；真实上传未知结果继续由宿主处理。

结构化页面资料

下载设置页面结构与接入边界 JSON，与上方TS/JS完整源码配合使用。

本页内容
个人设置四个设置分区接入与资源归属结构化页面资料
